page.layout: One sheet: an engraved coat of arms at the upper centre, with a crown above. Below it, a printed ornamental label frame with the printed word "Clafs". Handwritten shelf marks and notes in pencil and ink surround the arms and lie below the frame. No running text.
page.notes: Engraved coat of arms with crown, not transcribed. Handwritten notes are excluded: "Blondel", "8° O.K.", "clb" and "And 37" in a circle, the pencil shelf marks at the left, "LB 541, 941", "Haag II, 308", and the initials at the lower left. The ornamental label frame is printed; only its printed word "Clafs" is transcribed. The label's blank field has no printed text.
